targetAsset.description:
The asset to get events for. Used with the {@link #assetRefFieldMap} or
{@link #defaultAssetRefField} to filter events by asset.

fetchSpecMap.description:
The initial specs to use to fetch each event type. Also determines the event types to fetch.
Additional filters will be added to these specs.
The key is the event type, and the value is the fetch spec to use.
